{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = sales_df.isnull().sum()

# Check the data types
dtypes = sales_df.dtypes

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = sales_df.duplicated().sum()

# Check the distribution of the 'converted' column
converted_dist = sales_df['converted'].value_counts()

# Check the range of customer_age
age_range = (sales_df['customer_age'].min(), sales_df['customer_age'].max())

missing_values, dtypes, duplicates, converted_dist, age_range"}
